title: Quaternary Fault Lines
producer: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program
source_relationship: official producer-hosted USGS Qfaults service; exact equivalence to the 2024 HIFLD archive and the 2020 service edition is unresolved

historical_crosswalk.relationship: DHS crosswalk DOI is cited by the inventory; the exact record-level row was not independently re-fetched because the DataLumos project page returned an anonymous HTTP 403 challenge.

historical_archive.archive_note: The inventory date and archive modification date are not source release dates. The DataLumos view returned an anonymous Cloudflare challenge, so the archived file was not downloaded or compared in this audit.

upstream_lineage: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database (Qfaults)
USGS Earthquake Hazards Program Qfaults 2020 map release service

capture_2026-10-21.method: 565 anonymous GET requests: service/layer metadata, before/after counts and object-ID rosters, and 565 explicit-ID geometry pages of 200 IDs each; f=json, no outSR override.
capture_2026-10-21.completeness: complete for the observed live 112,809-feature roster; not proof of date, HIFLD archive equality, or a newly issued scientific edition
capture_2026-10-21.single_request_limit: 200 IDs per request succeeded; 1,000 IDs returned HTTP 413, so the pipeline uses 200-ID batches.
capture_2026-10-21.release_date_unknown_reason: The service declares a 2020 map release but does not expose a dated data-release or edition identifier; the inventory/archive dates are not release dates.

proposed_schema_contract.preserve_native_id: OBJECTID, unchanged; no substitute row identifiers
proposed_schema_contract.preserve_value_domains: last_review retained as source epoch milliseconds; string leading zeros and numeric precision retained
proposed_schema_contract.geometry: all native polyline XY paths in EPSG:3857 retained without reprojection, repair, or simplification
proposed_schema_contract.unexpected_fields_or_types: quarantine for review; do not drop or expand the published schema silently
proposed_schema_contract.publication: blocked pending source acceptance, schema/ID contract, baseline comparison, coverage/rights review, and release approval

pipeline_implementation.candidate_status: draft; local materialization evidence recorded separately
pipeline_implementation.release: candidate remains unapproved; no production publication
